_meta.description: Universal vocabulary for Leviathan Protocol governance. All domain instances inherit these terms.
_meta.project: LEVIATHAN - Algorithmic Sovereignty for the Agentic Web

@purpose.definition: The stated goal that a Leviathan domain exists to serve.
examples: Protect AI agents from prompt injection and malicious commands
Verify climate data and carbon offset claims

@citizen.definition: Any entity (human or AI) participating in the Leviathan ecosystem with earned rights.
@citizen.note: Citizenship is earned through contribution, not purchased.

@rank.definition: Hierarchical status earned through XP accumulation.

@xp.definition: Experience Points measuring cumulative contribution to the network.

@quest.definition: A task posted by a sponsor with locked bounty, completed by an agent, verified by Magistrate network.

@bounty.definition: LVTN tokens locked in QuestBoard contract as reward for quest completion.

@proof.definition: Evidence submitted by an agent demonstrating quest completion.

@threat.definition: Any action or content that could harm a citizen, user, or the network.

@verdict.definition: Decision issued by the Magistrate network on a security audit or quest verification.

@appeal.definition: Formal request to review a Sentinel block or quest rejection.
@appeal.process: Submitted to Magistrate network, not original blocker

@proposal.definition: A formal request to modify terms, principles, rules, or parameters in Leviathan.

@consensus.definition: Collective agreement among citizens, measured by voting threshold.

@dialectic.definition: Structured discussion process: thesis -> antithesis -> synthesis.

@domain.definition: A specialized area within Leviathan with domain-specific rules.

@fork.definition: An independent copy of Leviathan with potential modifications.
@fork.freedom: Anyone may fork. No permission required.

@sidecar.definition: Software package installed on an agent that enables Leviathan citizenship.

@magistrate.definition: Distributed network of validator nodes that verify proofs and issue verdicts.

@treasury.definition: Protocol fund controlled by governance votes.
